55:  * Usage:

77:       HttpClient httpClient,
78:       DruidNodeDiscoveryProvider druidNodeDiscoveryProvider,
79:       NodeRole nodeRoleToWatch,
80:       String leaderRequestPath
81:   )
82:   {

84:     this.druidNodeDiscoveryProvider = druidNodeDiscoveryProvider;
85:     this.nodeRoleToWatch = nodeRoleToWatch;
86:     this.leaderRequestPath = leaderRequestPath;

94:     }

107:   public void stop()

111:     }

113:     log.debug("Stopped.");
114:   }

116:   /**
117:    * Make a Request object aimed at the leader. Throws IOException if the leader cannot be located.
118:    */
119:   public Request makeRequest(HttpMethod httpMethod, String urlPath) throws IOException
120:   {
121:     Preconditions.checkState(lifecycleLock.awaitStarted(1, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS));
122:     return new Request(httpMethod, new URL(StringUtils.format("%s%s", getCurrentKnownLeader(true), urlPath)));
123:   }

125:   public StringFullResponseHolder go(Request request) throws IOException, InterruptedException
126:   {
127:     return go(request, new StringFullResponseHandler(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
128:   }

130:   /**
131:    * Executes a Request object aimed at the leader. Throws IOException if the leader cannot be located.
132:    */
133:   public <T, H extends FullResponseHolder<T>> H go(Request request, HttpResponseHandler<H, H> responseHandler)
134:       throws IOException, InterruptedException
135:   {
136:     Preconditions.checkState(lifecycleLock.awaitStarted(1, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS));
137:     for (int counter = 0; counter < MAX_RETRIES; counter++) {
138: 
139:       final H fullResponseHolder;
140: 
141:       try {
142:         try {
143:           fullResponseHolder = httpClient.go(request, responseHandler).get();
144:         }
145:         catch (ExecutionException e) {
146:           // Unwrap IOExceptions and ChannelExceptions, re-throw others
147:           Throwables.propagateIfInstanceOf(e.getCause(), IOException.class);
148:           Throwables.propagateIfInstanceOf(e.getCause(), ChannelException.class);
149:           throw new RE(e, "HTTP request to[%s] failed", request.getUrl());
150:         }
151:       }
152:       catch (IOException | ChannelException ex) {
153:         // can happen if the node is stopped.
154:         log.warn(ex, "Request[%s] failed.", request.getUrl());
155:         request = rebuildRequestAtLeader(request);
156:         continue;
157:       }
158: 
159:       if (HttpResponseStatus.TEMPORARY_REDIRECT.equals(fullResponseHolder.getResponse().getStatus())) {
160:         String redirectUrlStr = fullResponseHolder.getResponse().headers().get("Location");
161:         if (redirectUrlStr == null) {
162:           throw new IOE("No redirect location is found in response from url[%s].", request.getUrl());
163:         }
164: 
165:         log.info("Request[%s] received redirect response to location [%s].", request.getUrl(), redirectUrlStr);
166: 
167:         final URL redirectUrl;
168:         try {
169:           redirectUrl = new URL(redirectUrlStr);
170:         }
171:         catch (MalformedURLException ex) {
172:           throw new IOE(
173:               ex,
174:               "Malformed redirect location is found in response from url[%s], new location[%s].",
175:               request.getUrl(),
176:               redirectUrlStr
177:           );
178:         }
179: 
180:         //update known leader location
181:         currentKnownLeader.set(StringUtils.format(
182:             "%s://%s:%s",
183:             redirectUrl.getProtocol(),
184:             redirectUrl.getHost(),
185:             redirectUrl.getPort()
186:         ));
187: 
188:         request = withUrl(request, redirectUrl);
189:       } else {
190:         return fullResponseHolder;
191:       }
192:     }
193: 
194:     throw new IOE("Retries exhausted, couldn't fulfill request to [%s].", request.getUrl());

205:       throw new ISE(ex, "Couldn't find leader.");
206:     }
207: 
208:     if (responseHolder.getStatus().getCode() == 200) {
209:       String leaderUrl = responseHolder.getContent();
210: 
211:       //verify this is valid url
212:       try {
213:         URL validatedUrl = new URL(leaderUrl);
214:         currentKnownLeader.set(leaderUrl);
215: 
216:         // validatedUrl.toString() is returned instead of leaderUrl or else teamcity build fails because of breaking

218:         return validatedUrl.toString();
219:       }
220:       catch (MalformedURLException ex) {

222:       }
223:     }
224: 
225:     throw new ISE(

239:     if (leader == null) {

247:   private String pickOneHost()
248:   {
249:     Iterator<DiscoveryDruidNode> iter = druidNodeDiscovery.getAllNodes().iterator();

252:       return StringUtils.format(
253:           "%s://%s",
254:           node.getDruidNode().getServiceScheme(),
255:           node.getDruidNode().getHostAndPortToUse()
256:       );
257:     }
258: 
259:     return null;
260:   }

262:   private Request withUrl(Request old, URL url)
263:   {
264:     Request req = new Request(old.getMethod(), url);
265:     req.addHeaderValues(old.getHeaders());
266:     if (old.hasContent()) {
267:       req.setContent(old.getContent());
268:     }
269:     return req;
270:   }

272:   private Request rebuildRequestAtLeader(Request oldRequest) throws IOException
273:   {
274:     Iterator<DiscoveryDruidNode> iter = druidNodeDiscovery.getAllNodes().iterator();
275:     if (!iter.hasNext()) {
276:       currentKnownLeader.set(null);
277:       throw new IOE("No known server");
278:     }
279: 
280:     DiscoveryDruidNode leaderNode = iter.next();
281:     final String leaderBase = StringUtils.format(
282:         "%s://%s",
283:         leaderNode.getDruidNode().getServiceScheme(),
284:         leaderNode.getDruidNode().getHostAndPortToUse()
285:     );
286:     currentKnownLeader.set(leaderBase);
287: 
288:     final URL oldUrl = oldRequest.getUrl();
289:     try {
290:       final URL newUrl;
291:       if (oldUrl.getQuery() == null) {
292:         newUrl = new URL(StringUtils.format("%s%s", leaderBase, oldUrl.getPath()));
293:       } else {
294:         newUrl = new URL(StringUtils.format(
295:             "%s%s?%s",
296:             leaderBase,
297:             oldUrl.getPath(),
298:             oldUrl.getQuery()
299:         ));
300:       }
301:       Request req = new Request(oldRequest.getMethod(), newUrl);
302:       req.addHeaderValues(oldRequest.getHeaders());
303:       if (oldRequest.hasContent()) {
304:         req.setContent(oldRequest.getContent());
305:       }
306:       return req;
307:     }
308:     catch (MalformedURLException e) {
309:       // Not an IOException; this is our own fault.
310:       throw new ISE(
311:           e,
312:           "failed to build url with path[%] and query string [%s].",
313:           oldUrl.getPath(),
314:           oldUrl.getQuery()
315:       );
316:     }
317:   }

The fix is implemented and validated:

**`DruidLeaderClient.java`** (server/src/main/java/org/apache/druid/discovery/DruidLeaderClient.java):
- Added a new `go(request, responseHandler, Predicate<H> isAllowedResponse)` overload. Responses matching the caller-supplied predicate are returned as-is; any other response triggers a best-effort retry (like IOException/ChannelException) via `rebuildRequestAtLeader`, which re-resolves the leader and refreshes the cache, up to `MAX_RETRIES`, then throws `IOException`.
- The existing 1-arg and 2-arg `go` methods delegate to it, defaulting to only allowing 200 responses.

**Caller updates** so callers that explicitly handle non-200 statuses keep receiving them:
- `CoordinatorClient.isHandOffComplete` — allows 200 and 404 (null handoff check during rolling updates).
- `CoordinatorPollingBasicAuthorizerCacheManager.tryFetchGroupMappingMapsFromCoordinator` — allows 200 and 404 (backward-compat endpoint on older coordinators).

**Validation:**
- `DruidLeaderClientTest`: 6/6 pass, including the new `test503ResponseFromServerAndCacheRefresh` (was failing: 503 now refreshes the cache, re-resolves, and succeeds on retry with `getAllNodes` invoked exactly twice).
- `HttpIndexingServiceClientTest` (8), `LookupReferencesManagerTest` (18), `CoordinatorBasedSegmentHandoffNotifierTest` (6): all pass.
